import pandas as pd


def apply(df, ctx):
    out = df.copy()
    items = [
        "wb_gen_1", "wb_gen_2", "wb_phys_1", "wb_phys_2", "wb_phys_3", "wb_phys_4",
        "wb_phys_5", "wb_phys_6", "wb_phys_7", "wb_psych_1", "wb_psych_2", "wb_psych_3",
        "wb_psych_4", "wb_psych_5", "wb_psych_6", "wb_soc_1", "wb_soc_2",
    ]
    out["wb"] = out[items].mean(axis=1)
    return out
